snippet.text: forcing f z = !₂[(forceX + forceY/h)/2, (forceX - forceY/h)/2] with forceX = -(f 0 - ρ⟪B 0, tail f⟫)/(1+ρ²) and forceY = -⟪B 1, tail f⟫ (lines 82-87) — these are the same two rows applied to the projected forcing: with n = pack (βρ) (β•B 0), (tangentProj n f) 0 = (f 0 - ρ⟪B 0, tail f⟫)/(1+ρ²) and ⟪B 1, tail (tangentProj n f)⟫ = ⟪B 1, tail f⟫, so forceX = e_r^T(-tangentProj n f) and forceY = (B 1)^T(-tangentProj n f); the !₂[…] bracket is M⁻¹, i.e. p = (x + y/h)/2, q = (x - y/h)/2
